title: Death
subtitle: 「死亡／逝世／生命終結」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？
description: 「死亡／逝世／生命終結」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在特定語境中自然的替代表達？

words.note: 較正式，常用於某人的死亡，也可比喻某組織、制度或事物的終結。
words.example: The author's sudden demise shocked readers around the world.
words.exampleZh: 這位作家的突然逝世令全球讀者震驚。

exercises.original: The sudden death of the famous writer shocked readers around the world.
exercises.zh: 這位著名作家的突然逝世令全球讀者震驚。
exercises.upgrade: The sudden demise of the famous writer shocked readers around the world.

options.explanation: 正式書面語中很自然地表示某人的死亡。
也可表示逝世，但語氣更委婉、更溫和。
形容詞／名詞，不能直接替代 death。

exercises.original: The newspaper published an obituary after the actor's death.
exercises.zh: 演員逝世後，報章刊登了訃聞。
exercises.upgrade: The newspaper published an obituary after the actor's demise.

options.explanation: obituary + formal reporting 很適合 demise。

exercises.original: The biography examines the years leading up to the politician's death.
exercises.zh: 傳記探討這位政治人物逝世前的幾年。
exercises.upgrade: The biography examines the years leading up to the politician's demise.

options.explanation: 更像臨終階段，而不是死亡事件本身。
表示正在死亡的過程，語義不同。

words.note: 是 death 的委婉說法，特別常用於談及某人去世時。
words.example: We were saddened to hear of her passing.
words.exampleZh: 得知她離世，我們深感悲痛。

exercises.original: We were saddened to hear of her death.
exercises.zh: 得知她離世，我們深感悲痛。
exercises.upgrade: We were saddened to hear of her passing.

options.explanation: 慰問／悲痛語境中非常自然、委婉。
較正式、冷靜，少了慰問語氣。

exercises.original: The family announced his death in a short statement.
exercises.zh: 家屬在一份簡短聲明中宣布他離世。
exercises.upgrade: The family announced his passing in a short statement.

options.explanation: 家屬公告中語氣溫和、尊重。

exercises.original: Many colleagues shared memories after her death.
exercises.zh: 她離世後，許多同事分享了回憶。
exercises.upgrade: Many colleagues shared memories after her passing.

options.explanation: 只是其中一個後續儀式。
是動詞片語，不能直接放在 her 後作名詞。

words.note: 比 die 委婉，常用於口語和慰問語境。
words.example: He passed away peacefully at home.

exercises.original: He died peacefully at home surrounded by his family.
exercises.zh: 他在家中由家人陪伴，安詳離世。
exercises.upgrade: He passed away peacefully at home surrounded by his family.

options.explanation: 最自然、委婉地替代 died。
是形容詞／名詞，不能直接替代動詞。

exercises.original: She died after a long illness.
exercises.zh: 她長期患病後離世。
exercises.upgrade: She passed away after a long illness.

options.explanation: 人際和慰問語境中自然。
表示人死亡時現代英語通常顯得生硬、過時或不自然。

exercises.original: Her grandfather died at the age of ninety-two.
exercises.zh: 她祖父九十二歲離世。
exercises.upgrade: Her grandfather passed away at the age of ninety-two.

options.explanation: 在部分口語中可能委婉表示去世，但 passed away 更清楚、標準。
極少這樣用來描述一般人的死亡。
不能自然直接表示人死亡。

words.note: 常見於醫療、照護和倫理語境。
words.example: The family discussed end-of-life care with the doctor.
words.exampleZh: 家屬與醫生討論生命末期照護。

exercises.original: Doctors discussed care near the time of death with the family.
exercises.zh: 醫生與家屬討論生命末期照護。
exercises.upgrade: Doctors discussed end-of-life care with the family.

options.explanation: 醫療照護語境中最自然，指接近死亡的最後階段。
表示死亡本身，不是臨終照護階段。

exercises.original: The hospital provides support for patients approaching death.
exercises.zh: 醫院為接近生命終結的病人提供支援。
exercises.upgrade: The hospital provides support for patients approaching the end of life.

options.explanation: 醫療／照護語境中中性而正式。
動詞片語，不能直接作此名詞結構。
語法和語氣都不如 end of life。

exercises.original: The course covers ethical decisions made near death.
exercises.zh: 課程涵蓋生命末期的倫理決策。
exercises.upgrade: The course covers ethical decisions made near the end of life.

options.explanation: ethical decisions + near death 是典型 end-of-life context。
委婉死亡名詞，但不指末期階段。

words.example: The poem reflects on love, memory, and life's end.
words.exampleZh: 這首詩反思愛、記憶與生命終結。

exercises.original: The poem reflects on memory, love, and death.
exercises.zh: 這首詩反思記憶、愛與生命終結。
exercises.upgrade: The poem reflects on memory, love, and life's end.

options.explanation: 文學語境中自然、較溫和。

exercises.original: The novel explores how people think about death in old age.
exercises.zh: 小說探討人們在老年時如何思考生命終點。
exercises.upgrade: The novel explores how people think about life's end in old age.

options.explanation: 是死亡過程，不等於文學化「生命終點」。

exercises.original: The memoir becomes increasingly reflective as the writer approaches death.
exercises.zh: 隨著作者接近生命終點，回憶錄變得愈來愈富反思性。
exercises.upgrade: The memoir becomes increasingly reflective as the writer approaches life's end.

options.explanation: 表示死寂／無生命狀態，不自然指人的死亡事件。

words.note: 非常正式、法律或行政用語。
words.example: The property was transferred after the owner's decease.
words.exampleZh: 業主去世後，財產被轉移。

exercises.original: The property passed to his daughter after his death.
exercises.zh: 他去世後，財產轉移給女兒。
exercises.upgrade: The property passed to his daughter after his decease.

options.explanation: 較人情化，不是法律文件首選。

exercises.original: The agreement remains valid until the death of the policyholder.
exercises.zh: 協議在保單持有人死亡前一直有效。
exercises.upgrade: The agreement remains valid until the decease of the policyholder.

options.explanation: 正式保險／法律語境可用。
也正式，但法律文件中 decease 更傳統。

exercises.original: The estate must be administered after the owner's death.
exercises.zh: 業主去世後必須處理遺產。
exercises.upgrade: The estate must be administered after the owner's decease.

options.explanation: 語意可理解，但太非正式／委婉。
不是財產法律觸發事件。

words.note: 表示有人喪失生命，常見於事故、戰爭、災難和官方報告。
words.example: The accident resulted in loss of life.

exercises.original: The accident caused several deaths.
exercises.zh: 事故造成多人喪生。
exercises.upgrade: The accident resulted in loss of life.

options.explanation: 多用於個人死亡，不自然描述多宗事故死亡。
表示死亡率／死亡現象，不是某次事故造成的具體死亡。

exercises.original: Officials said the fire caused no deaths.
exercises.zh: 官員表示火災沒有造成生命損失。
exercises.upgrade: Officials said the fire caused no loss of life.

options.explanation: 官方事故說明中非常自然。
動詞片語，不適合此結構。

exercises.original: Safety measures are designed to prevent death during emergencies.
exercises.zh: 安全措施旨在防止緊急情況下有人喪生。
exercises.upgrade: Safety measures are designed to prevent loss of life during emergencies.

options.explanation: 安全／事故預防語境的標準正式表達。
法律／行政人事語氣，不自然。
語法上可理解但不如固定表達正式。

words.meaning: 死亡個案；死亡者；致命結果
words.note: 常用於事故、疾病、災難或統計語境中的死亡個案。

exercises.original: The crash caused two deaths.
exercises.zh: 這宗撞車事故造成兩人死亡。
exercises.upgrade: The crash caused two fatalities.

options.explanation: 事故統計中自然表示死亡個案／死亡者。

exercises.original: There were no deaths in the workplace accident.
exercises.zh: 這宗工業意外沒有造成死亡個案。
exercises.upgrade: There were no fatalities in the workplace accident.

options.explanation: 事故報告中常見固定用法。
是比率，不是死亡人數本身。

exercises.original: The disease caused several deaths during the outbreak.
exercises.zh: 疫情期間，這種疾病造成數宗死亡個案。
exercises.upgrade: The disease caused several fatalities during the outbreak.

options.explanation: 統計／公共健康報告中可用。

words.meaning: 死亡；生命終止（非常正式／罕見）
words.note: 在某些法律、宗教或舊式正式語境中可指死亡，但現代一般英語較少如此使用。
words.example: The document takes effect upon the person's expiry.
words.exampleZh: 該文件在該人死亡後生效。

exercises.original: The legal right ends upon the person's death.
exercises.zh: 該法律權利在該人死亡時終止。
exercises.upgrade: The legal right ends upon the person's expiry.

options.explanation: 在非常正式、舊式法律語境中可表示生命終止。

exercises.original: The document specifies what happens after the death of the holder.
exercises.zh: 文件訂明持有人死亡後的安排。
exercises.upgrade: The document specifies what happens after the holder's expiry.

options.explanation: 可出現於少數非常正式或舊式文件，但現代一般英語較少用。
其實更自然的正式人類死亡用詞之一。
通常用於證件／產品，不是人的死亡。

exercises.original: The clause becomes effective on the person's death.
exercises.zh: 條款在該人死亡時生效。
exercises.upgrade: The clause becomes effective on the person's expiry.

options.explanation: 屬非常正式／罕見的人員死亡用法。
不是法律生效的死亡事件。
現代英語通常表示期限屆滿，用人身上更不自然。

words.note: 在上下文清楚時，可以委婉地指生命結束。
words.example: He remained surrounded by family until the end.
words.exampleZh: 直到生命最後一刻，他都有家人陪伴。

exercises.original: He remained surrounded by family until his death.
exercises.zh: 直到生命最後一刻，他都有家人陪伴。
exercises.upgrade: He remained surrounded by family until the end.

options.explanation: 上下文清楚時可委婉指生命最後。
語義可行，但沒有 the end 那種委婉、連續陪伴感。
通常指故事／事件結尾，不自然直接指人的死亡。

exercises.original: She was conscious until shortly before death.
exercises.zh: 她直到生命快要終結前仍保持清醒。
exercises.upgrade: She remained conscious until shortly before the end.

options.explanation: 高度依賴上下文，但生命末期語境可自然理解。

exercises.original: The nurse stayed with him until death.
exercises.zh: 護士陪伴他直到生命最後。
exercises.upgrade: The nurse stayed with him until the end.

options.explanation: 在已知是生命末期的情境中，自然、委婉。

falseSynonyms.zh: 葬禮 ≠ 死亡 funeral 是死亡後舉行的儀式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His death occurred in May. His funeral was held a week later.

falseSynonyms.zh: 埋葬 ≠ 死亡 burial 是安葬遺體的行為／儀式。
悲傷 ≠ 死亡 grief 是對死亡或其他損失的情緒反應。
哀悼 ≠ 死亡 mourning 指哀悼過程或行為。
疾病 ≠ 死亡 disease 可能導致 death，但不是同義詞。
致命的 ≠ 死亡 fatal 是形容詞： 而 death 是名詞。
詞性陷阱 - die = 動詞，死亡 - death = 名詞，死亡 - dead = 形容詞，死去的
詞性和語義不同 - deceased = 已故的；死者 - decease = 死亡（正式名詞／動詞）
